ext_description.message: Open 3D models from MakerWorld and other sites already set up for your printer and slicer.

options_subtitle.message: Convert projects for your own printers, keeping the model's settings.

printers_empty.message: No printers yet. Add the ones you print with.

convert_hint.message: Try BetterBridge with a .3mf you already downloaded.

convert_failed.message: The project could not be converted. See the report.

convert_needs_map.message: This project has more filaments than the printer has extruders; choosing the assignment is coming soon.

conversion_basic.message: BetterBridge picks the safest settings: the project opens and slices in any slicer, with your printer's cooling and the model's print settings.

profiles_hint.message: The official profiles of each slicer, updated automatically. Your own presets will be available with the BetterBridge helper app.
